name: Belief intake (live belief catalog)
notes: LIVE since 2026-09-29 (cutover from the legacy belief_engine). Daily insights + timeline -> belief_extractor -> belief_dedup -> belief_revise -> contradiction fan-out, into the belief_intake_* tables in emi.db. Runs after daily_insights (00:05) and processes yesterday plus any unfinished earlier day. After the days it tags new and revised beliefs (belief_tags) and rewrites resources/kg_derived/resource_user_beliefs.json, which the routine writer, health and entertainment stages, feedback-extractor context and insights page read; the chat gate and meal lane read the tables directly.
